card.name: Digits inside numbers and statistics
card.fires_on: Single digits or commas partway through a multi-digit number, mostly in percentages, sample sizes (n=) and dose strengths with thousands. The first digit of the number is often the marked one.

modes.label: Digits in percentages and counts
modes.description: A leading or middle digit of a percent or participant count in results text.

modes.label: Comma or digit in large doses
modes.description: A comma or digit inside a thousands-size number such as units per dose or sample size.

modes.label: Dashed divider line
modes.description: A row of dashes after a section heading.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a number, such as a digit or comma in a percentage, patient count or dose amount.
